pages.en:
“No. I can't promise absolute obedience.”

“…Honestly. You're rejecting my very first condition? Who do you think you are?”

“It's only a hypothetical, but what if you proposed a plan that was obviously reckless? I couldn't agree to that.”

……まあいいわ。じゃあ、納得できる作戦なら従うってコトね」
「ああ。それなら守れる」

pages.en:
“I would never make a mistake like that. If it looked reckless to you, that would only mean you hadn't understood it, Emiya!

“…Oh, fine. Then you'll follow any plan you find convincing?”

“Yeah. I can promise that.”
